name: Office Depot/OfficeMax Teacher Discount
description: 25% back in Bonus Rewards on qualifying online purchases for verified teachers
fullDescription: Office Depot/OfficeMax gives verified teachers 25% back in Bonus Rewards on qualifying officedepot.com purchases, plus a 20% off coupon after verifying through ID.me.
whatTheyOffer:
- 25% back in Bonus Rewards on qualifying purchases at officedepot.com (instead of the usual 2%)
- 20% off one qualifying purchase coupon emailed after verification
- Classroom Wish List so parents and family can help stock your classroom
- Free Office Depot Rewards membership required
howToGetIt:
1. Create a free Office Depot Rewards account
2. Go to officedepot.com/l/rewards/teachers and click "Verify with ID.me"
3. Provide your teaching license number or other documentation
4. Stay logged into your verified account when shopping online so the offer applies automatically
keywords: Office Depot, OfficeMax, teacher discount, educator, 25% back, Bonus Rewards, ID.me, school supplies, classroom
